subject: Customer deletion sprint: schedule, evidence bundle, and signoff
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@harmoniahealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@harmoniahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Complete removal of prompts, outputs, and traces for tenant HARM-77

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for walking through the residency options yesterday. Per our compliance team we need a coordinated removal of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and related inference logs for our sandbox tenant HARM-77. Scope: prompts + assistant outputs + KV traces + short-term cache entries and associated audit logs for interactions prior to 2028-07-01.

Two asks:
- A proposed execution window this week (Harmonia prefers US-PST afternoon).
- A lightweight proof bundle (CSV manifest + log checksums and a signed statement) that we can attach to our audit record.

Appreciate a timeline and any customer-facing emails we should expect.

— Lena (Compliance, Harmonia Health)

[attachment: policy_request_20280708.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Complete removal of prompts, outputs, and traces for tenant HARM-77

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the clear scope. We can run a prioritized deletion sprint that targets the items you listed. High level plan:
1) Prep & validate scope (today) — confirm tenant ID, list of endpoints, and retention windows.
2) Execution window (we propose 2028-07-09 14:00–16:00 PDT) — ops will run the sweep, apply KV cache invalidation, and delete archived prompt-output bundles.
3) Proofpack delivery (within 24 hours after run) — CSV manifest of removed keys, SHA256 checksums, run logs, and a signed statement from Redwood Ops.

I copied Ben (ops lead) and Marissa (customer success lead) to coordinate the runbook and the customer-facing closure email. If 14:00–16:00 works, we will lock the window and send the pre-run notice to your ops address.

Action: please reply with confirmation for the 07/09 window or suggest an alternate afternoon slot.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | priya_natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@harmoniahealth.com>, ops@harmoniahealth.com
Date: 2028-07-08T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deletion sprint runbook and manifest (HARM-77)

Folks —

Confirmed: we will run the deletion window on 2028-07-09 at 14:00 PDT. Summary of the ops plan (excerpt from attached runbook):
- Target systems: hosted inference indices for tenant HARM-77, ephemeral KV caches on gpu-pool-3, and recent audit logs in the logindex service with retention tag = HARM-77-temp.
- Step 1 (14:00): Quiesce incoming requests for the tenant at the routing layer (10-minute drain).
- Step 2 (14:10): Execute prefix deletion job: prompts/*/HARM-77 and outputs/*/HARM-77. Job writes a manifest row per deletion (id, object_key, deletion_time, operator).
- Step 3 (14:40): Run KV sweep to evict live KV keys and purge tombstones.
- Step 4 (15:10): Collect run logs, generate checksums, and upload proofpack to S3.
- Step 5 (15:40): Re-open routing and perform smoke checks (sample queries) to confirm no resurfacing.

I've attached the runbook and a sample sweep_manifest CSV template. The final proofpack will include: sweep_manifest_20280709.csv, runbook_deletion_sprint_v1.pdf, and proofpack-logs-20280709.tar.gz. Expect delivery by 2028-07-10 14:00 PDT.

Operational notes: we will not touch backups that are under a separate BR policy without an explicit BR deletion request — I flagged that for the customer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook_deletion_sprint_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: sweep_manifest_20280708.csv (text/csv)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@harmoniahealth.com>, ops@harmoniahealth.com

Date: 2028-07-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deletion sprint completion and proofpack delivery — HARM-77

Hi Lena / Harmonia ops —

Run complete. Below is the customer-facing summary and the location of the evidence bundle. I included the exact manifest rows inline and attached the proofpack.

--- Customer-facing summary (please retain for audit) ---
Date of run: 2028-07-09 14:00–15:40 PDT
Scope: all prompt inputs, assistant outputs, ephemeral KV entries, and inference trace logs tagged to tenant HARM-77 with interactions occurring before 2028-07-01.
Run outcome: 3,142 objects removed; KV sweep cleared 9,214 keys; audit logs pruned for the specified window.
Proofpack contents (delivered at): https://s3.redwood-inference/proofs/harmonia/2028-07-09/proofpack-uuid
- sweep_manifest_20280709.csv — CSV with one row per deleted object (columns: object_key, object_type, deleted_at, operator_id, sha256).
- proofpack-logs-20280709.tar.gz — gzipped run logs and checksums.
- runbook_deletion_sprint_v1.pdf — executed runbook and operator checklist.

Inline manifest sample (first 3 rows):
"object_key","object_type","deleted_at","operator_id","sha256"

Next steps for Harmonia:
- Please confirm acceptance of the proofpack and reply with an "Accepted" or list any follow-up evidence required.
- If you require DocuSign attestation, we can provide a short statement for signature (I can initiate).

Acknowledged by Harmonia ops (reply inline):
> On Mon, Jul 9, 2028 at 17:03 +0000 Lena Ortiz wrote:
> Thanks — received and attaching to our audit. We accept the delivered proofpack. Can you also provide the short attestation for signature?

Response: We will generate the attestation and send a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks for the patience — closing the run from our side pending your acceptance.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
